nextGame.note: Saturday home game at Yulman Stadium against North Texas. Eleven o'clock in the morning, on ESPNU. Tulane has won five games and lost five, and one more win puts the Green Wave in a bowl game. North Texas has won seven games and lost three.

news.headline: Cooper Helmke is up for a national kicking award
news.summary: Tulane kicker Cooper Helmke is one of 20 players still in the running for the Lou Groza Award, which goes to the best kicker in the country. He has made 13 of his 15 field goals this year, and his longest was from 58 yards.

news.headline: Tulane's last road game is set for 2:30 Saturday
news.summary: Tulane plays at South Florida on Saturday, November 28, at half past two in the afternoon. The game is on ESPN+, which comes with YouTube TV at no extra charge.

news.headline: Tulane's Saturday kickoff is set for 11 in the morning
news.summary: Tulane plays North Texas at Yulman Stadium at 11 o'clock Saturday morning, on ESPNU. A win sends the Green Wave to a bowl game.

nextGame.note: Saturday morning home game in Gainesville. Eleven o'clock our time, on the SEC Network. It is Florida's last home game of the year. Florida has won six games and lost four and is already going to a bowl game. Vanderbilt has won four games and lost six.

news.headline: Five Florida players are out for Saturday
news.summary: Florida's injury list came out Wednesday night. Tight end Lacota Dippre, receiver Vernell Brown III, lineman Emeka Ugorji, safety DJ Coleman and lineman Jaden Robinson will all miss the Vanderbilt game.

news.headline: Neal Anderson is going into the Florida Sports Hall of Fame
news.summary: Anderson ran for 3,234 yards and 30 touchdowns for the Gators from 1982 to 1985, and only two Florida players have ever run for more. He went on to play eight seasons for the Chicago Bears, and he will be honored in Orlando next May.

news.headline: Jadan Baugh is up for the top running back award
news.summary: Florida running back Jadan Baugh is one of 10 players still in the running for the Doak Walker Award, which goes to the best running back in the country. He has run for 905 yards this year and leads the Southeastern Conference with 15 touchdowns.

nextGame.note: Saturday afternoon home game in Austin. Half past two our time. Texas has won eight games and lost two. Arkansas has won four games and lost six.

news.headline: Colin Simmons is a finalist for a national award
news.summary: Texas pass rusher Colin Simmons is one of four finalists for the Lombardi Award, which goes to the best lineman or linebacker in the country. The winner is named on December 9 in Houston.

news.headline: Texas moves up to fifth in the playoff rankings
news.summary: The committee that picks the playoff teams put Texas fifth on Tuesday, one spot higher than last week. Twelve teams make the playoff, and Texas has won eight games and lost two.

news.headline: Arch Manning will walk with the seniors Saturday
news.summary: Texas honors its seniors before Saturday's home game against Arkansas, and Manning said Monday he will take part. He also said he is not thinking about next year yet, and walking on senior day does not stop him from coming back.

nextGame.note: Sunday road game at Chicago. Noon our time, on Fox 8. Chicago has won seven games and lost two. The Saints have won three and lost six, and Carolina leads the division with four wins and five losses.

news.headline: Seven Saints did not practice on Wednesday
news.summary: Center Erik McCoy, tackles Taliese Fuaga and Asim Richards, linebacker Pete Werner and cornerback Martin Emerson all sat out practice. Alvin Kamara was given the day off to rest and safety Justin Reid was away on a personal matter, so neither one is hurt.

news.headline: Kaden Elliss made 15 tackles against Carolina
news.summary: The Saints named linebacker Kaden Elliss their best player in Sunday's loss to Carolina. He made 15 tackles, sacked the quarterback once and knocked down a pass.

news.headline: Tyler Shough says he has to keep getting better
news.summary: The Saints quarterback has thrown for 2,173 yards and 15 touchdowns in nine starts this year, with 7 passes picked off. He said he learns something about himself every week, and that the whole offense has to play better.

nextGame.note: Friday is IUP's first game of the national tournament, against Lock Haven. Half past twelve our time, half past one theirs. Every IUP volleyball game is shown free on the PSAC Sports Digital Network app, so tap the link just above on game day and look for the match. You can also search PSAC on a phone, an Apple TV or a Fire TV, or open psacsportsdigitalnetwork.com/iupathletics in a browser. The games are at the Highmark Events Center in Erie, Pennsylvania, at Gannon, who beat IUP for the conference title on Sunday. Gannon is hosting, so Friday's match may show up under Gannon on the app instead, at psacsportsdigitalnetwork.com/gannonsports. IUP is the second seed with twenty-three wins and six losses. Lock Haven has won twenty games and lost seven, and this is its first national tournament since 2012. If IUP wins Friday it plays again Saturday at three o'clock our time, against Fairmont State or Clarion, and the region final is Sunday at three.

news.headline: IUP is in the national tournament for a fourth straight year
news.summary: IUP is the second seed in the Atlantic Region and opens Friday against Lock Haven in Erie, Pennsylvania. It is the fourth year in a row the Crimson Hawks have made the national tournament.

news.headline: Peyton Belcher had 6 kills against Gannon
news.summary: Peyton was back on the court Saturday night for the first time since October 23. She played three of the four sets and had 6 kills on 23 swings with 3 errors, plus a block at the net.

news.headline: Peyton Belcher is named a Provost Scholar
news.summary: IUP put Peyton on its fall list of Provost Scholars, which the school gives to juniors and seniors with a grade average of 3.5 or better. A student can only get it once, and she is studying psychology.

nextGame.note: Baseball is finished until the spring. The Yankees open the new season at home against Toronto on Thursday, March 25, at twenty-five to one in the afternoon. No channel has been announced yet.

news.headline: David Bednar takes the Yankees' one-year offer
news.summary: The Yankees' closer accepted a one-year contract worth 23.15 million dollars on Tuesday instead of looking for a longer deal somewhere else. He saved 35 games for New York this season and gave up 2.47 runs every nine innings.

news.headline: The Yankees bring back pitcher Chase Hampton
news.summary: New York claimed Chase Hampton off waivers from Baltimore on Tuesday. The Yankees drafted him back in 2022, and he has not pitched in the major leagues yet.

news.headline: Brett Gardner is on the Hall of Fame ballot
news.summary: Brett Gardner played 14 seasons and all of them for the Yankees. He is on the Hall of Fame ballot for the first time.

news.headline: Evangel ends Warren Easton's season 52-14
news.summary: The Eagles lost Friday night in Shreveport in the first round of the state playoffs. Warren Easton finishes the year with four wins and seven losses.

news.headline: Warren Easton makes the playoffs and will travel to Shreveport
news.summary: The state playoff brackets came out Sunday. Warren Easton is the 21st seed and plays at Evangel in Shreveport, which is the 12th seed.

news.headline: Bonnabel beats Warren Easton 29-28
news.summary: The Eagles lost by one point at home Thursday night in the last game of their regular season. Warren Easton finishes the year 4-6, and the state playoff pairings are not out yet.
